items.title: Bitcoin steadies near $84k after bond yields hit a 2007 high
items.take: BTC dipped toward ~$83.3k as 10Y yields spiked to 2007 highs, then found dip buyers; USD bid, equities soft.
items.why_matters: Macro/liquidity: higher yields + MOVE spike tighten financial conditions even when weekly Fed net expands.

items.title: Bitcoin breakout cools as Fed rate-hike bets climb
items.take: BTC slipped back under $85k from ~$87.4k high; CME FedWatch ~75% October hike odds; SOL/BNB held up better.
items.why_matters: Regime: hike repricing can cut risk appetite and leverage even while RSDH stays BULL/SOL-heavy.

items.title: Bitcoin's ~$16B quarterly options settlement arrives with a call-heavy book
items.take: Deribit Friday Sep 25 expiry ~$15.9B BTC + $2.1B ETH options; call-heavy (P/C 0.69); dealer gamma hedging may fade post-settle.
items.why_matters: Positioning/vol: large expiry can reset short-term ranges and unwind rally-supporting hedge flows today.

items.title: Fed moves on proposals to implement GENIUS Act for stablecoins
items.take: Fed proposed rules to implement last year's GENIUS Act, including stablecoin yield-program governance.
items.why_matters: Liquidity plumbing: clearer stablecoin rules can affect onshore USD crypto liquidity channels over time.

items.title: Bitcoin Magazine: traders brace for ~$15B options expiry
items.take: Quarterly BTC options expiry Friday with bullish call stacks at $85k/$90k/$100k; spot near $84–85k into settle.
items.why_matters: Confirms expiry as today's key derivatives event for short-horizon BTC path around Base band.
